text:
Alex (Partnerships): PolarisCloud reached out — they'd like Redwood in their new north-fjord marketplace. Request: pilot + SKU + telemetry hook + data residency note.
Mina (Partnerships): key asks? capacity? any compliance flags?
Polaris PM: initial entitlement: 16 reserved GPUs, burst to 48 for first 21 days. Must support EU data residency and a marketplace metering API (meter-v2). Also prefer customer KMS for enterprise buys.
Jon (Cloud Ops): 16 is doable but needs a dedicated nodepool in fjord-1 with AMI bake for their hardware (TensorCore family). ETA: 5 business days including image validation.
Priya (SRE): will add region SLIs + canary plan. propose 48h canary: 6h smoke, 42h soak. Need Polaris to mirror routing and provide staging creds.
Alex (Partnerships): Polaris also asks for signed attestation that TensorCore firmware is present and validated in our marketplace images. Vendor artifacts behind partner portal.
Felix (Legal): attestation ok with limited language. I'll draft minimal attestation and DPA addendum for data residency and KMS migration. Need Polaris legal contact.
Mina (Partnerships): dropping Polaris SKU suggestion:
```
SKU: redwood-inference.north-fjord.v1
Plan: reserved-16
Burst: burst-48
Metering: meter-v2
KMS: customer-ok
HW: tensorcore-certified
```
Jon (Cloud Ops): TensorCore drivers need kernel modules + firmware blobs. If vendor access delayed, fallback to standard-gpu SKU mapping. Also need permissions to push marketplace AMI.
Priya (SRE): for metering API we need sample events and a staging endpoint to validate billing feed. Polaris, can you share schema?
Polaris PM: will attach schema and staging creds by EOD. We can hold capacity for 72h around canary if requested.
OnboardBot: ticket #PRT-4788 created: "Polaris North-Fjord Marketplace Onramp" assigned to Alex, Jon, Priya. ETA infra: 5 days.
Felix (Legal): I'll prepare DPA + attestation template and target internal review in 48 hours. Also recommend a clause for key rotation and audit logs.
Mina (Partnerships): next steps: Mina to collect Polaris legal contact + vendor portal link; Jon to open infra PR for AMI bake & nodepool; Priya to draft canary runbook + SLI; Felix to draft legal docs. Sync Mon 09:30 CET.
Jon (Cloud Ops): potential blocker: TensorCore redistributor agreement. If vendor creds don't arrive, we'll propose fallback SKU: redwood-inference.north-fjord.fallback (standard-gpu).
Mina (Partnerships): I'll ask Polaris for a 72h capacity hold and vendor access.
Priya (SRE): once staging creds arrive I'll spin up the webhook consumer and run a dry canary.
Alex (Partnerships): thanks team — I'll send calendar invite and loop in Polaris PM. :rocket:
